text:
julia: Heads up — cutover litmus tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need owner for CR fallback if egress to customer fails. Also any last-minute net cert rotation concerns? :eyes:

matt: I can own CR fallback. Will be on-call. I'll prepare a runbook snippet and coordinate with lucy-net. :thumbsup:

lucy-net: We'll run the litmus probes at 08:30 PT and validate egress via the relay. Need list of test prefixes and IP egress ranges.

julia: test prefixes: /health, /v1/generate, /v1/kvcache. Egress ranges posted in infra doc but I'll paste them in the runbook.

alex: small heads up — PR 4823 (rollout-latency-fix) still needs one more review from platform. I can merge after matt's approval. If we merge after 06:00 PT, CI will trigger canary. @matt you good?

matt: reviewed, leaving one nit inline. OK to merge after fix.

sara: airgap cert rotation note — customer has automated cert pull around 02:00 local. If they rotate during our cutover, TLS handshake may fail. Recommend explicit fallback to internal relay + fail-open to secondary region as temporary mitigation.

lucy-net: we can add relay fallback; need to update CDN/edge config. Filing a quick change: edge -> relay fallback order, will share link.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-start 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z by @ci-bot. :calendar:

julia: Runbook test commands (paste into preflight):

curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://customer-edge.example.com/health
curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' https://customer-edge.example.com/v1/generate

matt: also add watch commands for kube logs:

kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=edge-proxy -f

alex: cross-team ask: who owns telemetry regression alerts during canary? @sara?

sara: yep I'll own telemetry. I'll push a temporary alert to PagerDuty if token error rate > 0.5% for 5m and hit the channel.

julia: Great — owners: matt (CR fallback), lucy-net (relay/fallback config), alex (PR merge window), sara (telemetry). Can everyone ack?

matt: ack :thumbsup:

lucy-net: ack

alex: ack

sara: ack

julia: I'll DM legal the ACL for the customer egress list and post a final preflight at 07:00 PT tomorrow. Thanks everyone — see you on standby. :rocket:
